g.text: What changes when the breeding-value cloud turns?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #576e74

g.text: The surface, population mean and two principal variances stay fixed. Only the direction of genetic variation changes.

g.text: Side view along the long axis

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #576e74

g.text: Solid: fitness surface · Dashed: fitted plane

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #19343c

g.text: Dots are equally weighted parents. The ellipse contains 90% of the model population; + marks the fitness peak.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #576e74

g.text: The index uses both traits. At 90° the slice is flat to first order, but the cloud still has some width towards the peak.
